blocks.prompt: 5 (i) Solve the following system by reducing its augmented matrix to the echelon form and the reduced echelon form: \(x_1 + 2x_2 - 2x_3 = -1\), \(2x_1 + 3x_2 + x_3 = 1\), \(5x_1 + 4x_2 - 3x_3 = 1\)
blocks.explanation:
Teen equations ka non-homogeneous system hai (constants zero nahi), aur hal \([A \mid B]\) par row operations se karna hai.
Teeno unknowns nikalne hain, aur sawal dono forms maang raha hai.
Plan: pehle echelon form aur back substitution; phir aage reduced echelon form tak ja kar jawab seedha parhna; aakhir mein tasdeeq.
Dhyan dein: echelon form mein har leading 1 pichhli row ke leading 1 se right taraf hota hai aur us ke neeche sab zero hote hain; reduced echelon form mein us ke upar bhi zero hote hain. Har row operation mein constant (lakeer ke baad wala number) bhi badalta hai, aksar students isi ko bhool jate hain. Fractions se bachne ke liye pehle aisi row upar layein jis ka leading entry 1 ho, ya do rows ko aapas mein minus kar ke saaf row banayein. Aakhir mein jawab ko asal equations mein zaroor check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x_1 + 2x_2 - 2x_3 = -1\), \(2x_1 + 3x_2 + x_3 = 1\), \(5x_1 + 4x_2 - 3x_3 = 1\)
Humein find karna hai: augmented matrix ko echelon form aur reduced echelon form mein la kar \(x_1, x_2, x_3\).
Tareeqa: Augmented matrix \([A \mid B]\) likhenge, yani coefficients aur constants ek hi matrix mein, beech mein lakeer. Row operations equations ko aisi equations mein badalte hain jin ka hal wohi rehta hai. Echelon form mein leading 1 aur un ke neeche zero hote hain, phir back substitution karte hain. Reduced echelon form mein leading 1 ke upar bhi zero hote hain, aur jawab seedha parh liya jata hai.

Augmented matrix
\[\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & -2 & -1 \\ 2 & 3 & 1 & 1 \\ 5 & 4 & -3 & 1\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: Har row ek equation hai: lakeer se pehle coefficients, aur lakeer ke baad us equation ka constant. Row ke saath poori equation badalti hai, is liye constant ko kabhi na bhoolein.

Column 1 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_2 + (-2)R_1 \to R_2'\), \(R_3 + (-5)R_1 \to R_3'\)
\(R_2'\): \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(3 - 4 = -1\), \(1 + 4 = 5\) | \(1 + 2 = 3\)
\(R_3'\): \(5 - 5 = 0\), \(4 - 10 = -6\), \(-3 + 10 = 7\) | \(1 + 5 = 6\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & -1 & 5 & 3 \\ 0 & -6 & 7 & 6\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_1\) ka leading entry pehle se 1 hai. \(R_2\) ka 2 mitane ke liye \(2R_1\) minus kiya aur \(R_3\) ka 5 mitane ke liye \(5R_1\) minus kiya. Constants wala column bhi saath badalta hai.

Row 2 mein leading 1
Row operation: \((-1)R_2 \to R_2'\)
\(R_2'\): \(0\), \(1\), \(-5\) | \(-3\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & -5 & -3 \\ 0 & -6 & 7 & 6\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_2\) ka pivot \(-1\) hai; poori row ko \(-1\) se zarb kiya to sab signs badal gaye aur pivot 1 ho gaya.

Column 2 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_3 + 6R_2 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(-6 + 6 = 0\), \(7 - 30 = -23\) | \(6 - 18 = -12\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & -5 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -23 & -12\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) ka column 2 wala entry \(-6\) hai, \(6R_2\) jama karne se zero ho gaya.

Row 3 mein leading 1
Row operation: \(\left(-\frac{1}{23}\right)R_3 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0\), \(0\), \(1\) | \(\frac{12}{23}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & -5 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & \frac{12}{23}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) ko \(-23\) se divide kiya. Ab matrix (row) echelon form mein hai: diagonal par 1 aur un ke neeche sab zero.

Echelon form se back substitution
Echelon form ka matlab yeh system hai
\[x_1 + 2x_2 - 2x_3 = -1\]
\[x_2 - 5x_3 = -3\]
\[x_3 = \frac{12}{23}\]
Aakhri equation se shuru kar ke upar ki taraf chalein:
\[x_3 = \dfrac{12}{23}\]
\[x_2 = -3 + 5\left(\frac{12}{23}\right)\]
\[x_2 = -\dfrac{9}{23}\]
\[x_1 = -1 - 2\left(-\frac{9}{23}\right) + 2\left(\frac{12}{23}\right)\]
\[x_1 = \dfrac{19}{23}\]
Kyun: Aakhri row mein sirf ek unknown bacha hai, us ki value seedhi mil jati hai. Phir us se upar wali row mein sirf ek naya unknown hota hai, aur yun neeche se upar sab values mil jati hain. Isi ko back substitution kehte hain.

Reduced form: column 2 mein pivot ke upar zero
Row operation: \(R_1 + (-2)R_2 \to R_1'\)
\(R_1'\): \(1 + 0 = 1\), \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(-2 + 10 = 8\) | \(-1 + 6 = 5\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 8 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -5 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & \frac{12}{23}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: Reduced echelon form mein pivot ke neeche hi nahi, upar bhi zero chahiye. \(R_1\) ke column 2 mein 2 hai, is liye \(2R_2\) minus kiya.

Column 3 mein pivot ke upar zero
Row operation: \(R_1 + (-8)R_3 \to R_1'\), \(R_2 + 5R_3 \to R_2'\)
\(R_1'\): \(1 + 0 = 1\), \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(8 - 8 = 0\) | \(5 - \frac{96}{23} = \frac{19}{23}\)
\(R_2'\): \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(1 + 0 = 1\), \(-5 + 5 = 0\) | \(-3 + \frac{60}{23} = -\frac{9}{23}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 0 & \frac{19}{23} \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -\frac{9}{23} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & \frac{12}{23}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_1\) mein 8 hai to \(8R_3\) minus kiya; \(R_2\) mein \(-5\) hai to \(5R_3\) jama kiya. Fractions ka common denominator 23 hai: \(5 - \frac{96}{23} = \frac{115 - 96}{23} = \frac{19}{23}\). Ab left hissa \(I_3\) hai, yani reduced echelon form.

Reduced echelon form se jawab parhein
\[x_1 = \dfrac{19}{23}\]
\[x_2 = -\dfrac{9}{23}\]
\[x_3 = \dfrac{12}{23}\]
Kyun: Reduced form ki har row seedha keh rahi hai: yeh unknown is number ke barabar hai. Dono tareeqon (back substitution aur reduced form) se ek hi jawab aaya, jo hamare kaam ki pehli tasdeeq hai.

Tasdeeq: asal equations mein rakh kar
\[\left(\frac{19}{23}\right) + 2\left(-\frac{9}{23}\right) - 2\left(\frac{12}{23}\right) = -1 \;\checkmark\]
\[2\left(\frac{19}{23}\right) + 3\left(-\frac{9}{23}\right) + \left(\frac{12}{23}\right) = 1 \;\checkmark\]
\[5\left(\frac{19}{23}\right) + 4\left(-\frac{9}{23}\right) - 3\left(\frac{12}{23}\right) = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Tasdeeq hamesha asal (di gayi) equations mein karein, reduced equations mein nahi, kyunke agar beech mein koi ghalti hui ho to reduced equations bhi ghalat hongi.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) Solve the following system by reducing its augmented matrix to the echelon form and the reduced echelon form: \(x + 2y + z = 2\), \(2x + y + 2z = 3\), \(2x + 3y - z = 7\)
blocks.explanation:
Teen equations ka non-homogeneous system hai (constants zero nahi), aur hal \([A \mid B]\) par row operations se karna hai.
Teeno unknowns nikalne hain, aur sawal dono forms maang raha hai.
Plan: pehle echelon form aur back substitution; phir aage reduced echelon form tak ja kar jawab seedha parhna; aakhir mein tasdeeq.
Dhyan dein: echelon form mein har leading 1 pichhli row ke leading 1 se right taraf hota hai aur us ke neeche sab zero hote hain; reduced echelon form mein us ke upar bhi zero hote hain. Har row operation mein constant (lakeer ke baad wala number) bhi badalta hai, aksar students isi ko bhool jate hain. Fractions se bachne ke liye pehle aisi row upar layein jis ka leading entry 1 ho, ya do rows ko aapas mein minus kar ke saaf row banayein. Aakhir mein jawab ko asal equations mein zaroor check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x + 2y + z = 2\), \(2x + y + 2z = 3\), \(2x + 3y - z = 7\)
Humein find karna hai: augmented matrix ko echelon form aur reduced echelon form mein la kar \(x, y, z\).
Tareeqa: Augmented matrix \([A \mid B]\) likhenge, yani coefficients aur constants ek hi matrix mein, beech mein lakeer. Row operations equations ko aisi equations mein badalte hain jin ka hal wohi rehta hai. Echelon form mein leading 1 aur un ke neeche zero hote hain, phir back substitution karte hain. Reduced echelon form mein leading 1 ke upar bhi zero hote hain, aur jawab seedha parh liya jata hai.

Augmented matrix
\[\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 3 & -1 & 7\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: Har row ek equation hai: lakeer se pehle coefficients, aur lakeer ke baad us equation ka constant. Row ke saath poori equation badalti hai, is liye constant ko kabhi na bhoolein.

Column 1 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_2 + (-2)R_1 \to R_2'\), \(R_3 + (-2)R_1 \to R_3'\)
\(R_2'\): \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(1 - 4 = -3\), \(2 - 2 = 0\) | \(3 - 4 = -1\)
\(R_3'\): \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(3 - 4 = -1\), \(-1 - 2 = -3\) | \(7 - 4 = 3\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 3\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_2\) aur \(R_3\) dono ka pehla entry 2 hai, is liye dono mein se \(2R_1\) minus kiya.

Row 2 mein leading 1
Row operation: \(\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)R_2 \to R_2'\)
\(R_2'\): \(0\), \(1\), \(0\) | \(\frac{1}{3}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \frac{1}{3} \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 3\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_2\) ka pivot \(-3\) hai, is liye poori row ko \(-3\) se divide kiya. Notice karein ke \(R_2\) se seedha \(y = \frac{1}{3}\) nazar aa raha hai, kyunke us mein \(z\) ka coefficient 0 hai.

Column 2 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_3 + R_2 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(-1 + 1 = 0\), \(-3 + 0 = -3\) | \(3 + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{10}{3}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \frac{1}{3} \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & \frac{10}{3}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) ka column 2 wala entry \(-1\) hai, \(R_2\) jama karne se zero. Constants: \(3 + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{10}{3}\).

Row 3 mein leading 1
Row operation: \(\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)R_3 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0\), \(0\), \(1\) | \(-\frac{10}{9}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \frac{1}{3} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{10}{9}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) ko \(-3\) se divide kiya: \(\frac{10}{3} \div (-3) = -\frac{10}{9}\). Ab matrix echelon form mein hai.

Echelon form se back substitution
Echelon form ka matlab yeh system hai
\[x + 2y + z = 2\]
\[y = \frac{1}{3}\]
\[z = -\frac{10}{9}\]
Aakhri equation se shuru kar ke upar ki taraf chalein:
\[z = -\dfrac{10}{9}\]
\[y = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[x = 2 - 2\left(\frac{1}{3}\right) - \left(-\frac{10}{9}\right)\]
\[x = \dfrac{22}{9}\]
Kyun: Aakhri row mein sirf ek unknown bacha hai, us ki value seedhi mil jati hai. Phir us se upar wali row mein sirf ek naya unknown hota hai, aur yun neeche se upar sab values mil jati hain. Isi ko back substitution kehte hain.

Reduced form: column 2 mein pivot ke upar zero
Row operation: \(R_1 + (-2)R_2 \to R_1'\)
\(R_1'\): \(1 + 0 = 1\), \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(1 + 0 = 1\) | \(2 - \frac{2}{3} = \frac{4}{3}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & \frac{4}{3} \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \frac{1}{3} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{10}{9}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_1\) ke column 2 mein 2 hai, \(2R_2\) minus kiya. \(2 - \frac{2}{3} = \frac{4}{3}\).

Column 3 mein pivot ke upar zero
Row operation: \(R_1 + (-1)R_3 \to R_1'\)
\(R_1'\): \(1 + 0 = 1\), \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(1 - 1 = 0\) | \(\frac{4}{3} + \frac{10}{9} = \frac{22}{9}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 0 & \frac{22}{9} \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & \frac{1}{3} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{10}{9}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_1\) ke column 3 mein 1 hai, \(R_3\) minus kiya: \(\frac{4}{3} + \frac{10}{9} = \frac{12 + 10}{9} = \frac{22}{9}\). \(R_2\) ke column 3 mein pehle se 0 hai. Yeh reduced echelon form hai.

Reduced echelon form se jawab parhein
\[x = \dfrac{22}{9}\]
\[y = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[z = -\dfrac{10}{9}\]
Kyun: Reduced form ki har row seedha keh rahi hai: yeh unknown is number ke barabar hai. Dono tareeqon (back substitution aur reduced form) se ek hi jawab aaya, jo hamare kaam ki pehli tasdeeq hai.

Tasdeeq: asal equations mein rakh kar
\[\left(\frac{22}{9}\right) + 2\left(\frac{1}{3}\right) + \left(-\frac{10}{9}\right) = 2 \;\checkmark\]
\[2\left(\frac{22}{9}\right) + \left(\frac{1}{3}\right) + 2\left(-\frac{10}{9}\right) = 3 \;\checkmark\]
\[2\left(\frac{22}{9}\right) + 3\left(\frac{1}{3}\right) - \left(-\frac{10}{9}\right) = 7 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Tasdeeq hamesha asal (di gayi) equations mein karein, reduced equations mein nahi, kyunke agar beech mein koi ghalti hui ho to reduced equations bhi ghalat hongi.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iii) Solve the following system by reducing its augmented matrix to the echelon form and the reduced echelon form: \(x_1 + 4x_2 + x_3 = 2\), \(2x_1 + x_2 - 2x_3 = 9\), \(3x_1 + x_2 - x_3 = 12\)
blocks.explanation:
Teen equations ka non-homogeneous system hai (constants zero nahi), aur hal \([A \mid B]\) par row operations se karna hai.
Teeno unknowns nikalne hain, aur sawal dono forms maang raha hai.
Plan: pehle echelon form aur back substitution; phir aage reduced echelon form tak ja kar jawab seedha parhna; aakhir mein tasdeeq.
Dhyan dein: echelon form mein har leading 1 pichhli row ke leading 1 se right taraf hota hai aur us ke neeche sab zero hote hain; reduced echelon form mein us ke upar bhi zero hote hain. Har row operation mein constant (lakeer ke baad wala number) bhi badalta hai, aksar students isi ko bhool jate hain. Fractions se bachne ke liye pehle aisi row upar layein jis ka leading entry 1 ho, ya do rows ko aapas mein minus kar ke saaf row banayein. steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x_1 + 4x_2 + x_3 = 2\), \(2x_1 + x_2 - 2x_3 = 9\), \(3x_1 + x_2 - x_3 = 12\)
Humein find karna hai: augmented matrix ko echelon form aur reduced echelon form mein la kar \(x_1, x_2, x_3\).
Tareeqa: Augmented matrix \([A \mid B]\) likhenge, yani coefficients aur constants ek hi matrix mein, beech mein lakeer. Row operations equations ko aisi equations mein badalte hain jin ka hal wohi rehta hai. Echelon form mein leading 1 aur un ke neeche zero hote hain, phir back substitution karte hain. Reduced echelon form mein leading 1 ke upar bhi zero hote hain, aur jawab seedha parh liya jata hai.

Augmented matrix
\[\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 4 & 1 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 & 9 \\ 3 & 1 & -1 & 12\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: Har row ek equation hai: lakeer se pehle coefficients, aur lakeer ke baad us equation ka constant. Row ke saath poori equation badalti hai, is liye constant ko kabhi na bhoolein.

Column 1 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_2 + (-2)R_1 \to R_2'\), \(R_3 + (-3)R_1 \to R_3'\)
\(R_2'\): \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(1 - 8 = -7\), \(-2 - 2 = -4\) | \(9 - 4 = 5\)
\(R_3'\): \(3 - 3 = 0\), \(1 - 12 = -11\), \(-1 - 3 = -4\) | \(12 - 6 = 6\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 4 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -7 & -4 & 5 \\ 0 & -11 & -4 & 6\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_2\) mein se \(2R_1\) aur \(R_3\) mein se \(3R_1\) minus kiya, taa ke column 1 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero aa jayein.

Divide karne se pehle row 3 ko aasaan karein
Row operation: \(R_3 + (-1)R_2 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(-11 + 7 = -4\), \(-4 + 4 = 0\) | \(6 - 5 = 1\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 4 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -7 & -4 & 5 \\ 0 & -4 & 0 & 1\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: Agar abhi \(R_2\) ko \(-7\) se divide karte to sevenths (\(\frac{1}{7}\) wale fractions) aa jate. \(R_3 - R_2\) karne se column 3 ka \(-4\) cancel ho gaya aur row \((0, -4, 0 \mid 1)\) bahut saaf ban gayi. Yeh bhi ek jaiz row operation hai.

Aasaan row ko doosre number par layein
Row operation: \(R_2 \leftrightarrow R_3\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 4 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -4 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & -7 & -4 & 5\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \((0, -4, 0 \mid 1)\) wali row ko pivot row banana aasaan hai, is liye \(R_2\) aur \(R_3\) ki jagah badal di.

Row 2 mein leading 1
Row operation: \(\left(-\frac{1}{4}\right)R_2 \to R_2'\)
\(R_2'\): \(0\), \(1\), \(0\) | \(-\frac{1}{4}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 4 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -\frac{1}{4} \\ 0 & -7 & -4 & 5\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_2\) ko \(-4\) se divide kiya; is row se seedha \(x_2 = -\frac{1}{4}\) mil raha hai.

Column 2 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_3 + 7R_2 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(-7 + 7 = 0\), \(-4 + 0 = -4\) | \(5 - \frac{7}{4} = \frac{13}{4}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 4 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -\frac{1}{4} \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & \frac{13}{4}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) ka column 2 wala entry \(-7\) hai, \(7R_2\) jama kiya. Constants: \(5 - \frac{7}{4} = \frac{20 - 7}{4} = \frac{13}{4}\).

Row 3 mein leading 1
Row operation: \(\left(-\frac{1}{4}\right)R_3 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0\), \(0\), \(1\) | \(-\frac{13}{16}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 4 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -\frac{1}{4} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{13}{16}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) ko \(-4\) se divide kiya: \(\frac{13}{4} \div (-4) = -\frac{13}{16}\). Ab matrix echelon form mein hai.

Echelon form se back substitution
Echelon form ka matlab yeh system hai
\[x_1 + 4x_2 + x_3 = 2\]
\[x_2 = -\frac{1}{4}\]
\[x_3 = -\frac{13}{16}\]
Aakhri equation se shuru kar ke upar ki taraf chalein:
\[x_3 = -\dfrac{13}{16}\]
\[x_2 = -\dfrac{1}{4}\]
\[x_1 = 2 - 4\left(-\frac{1}{4}\right) - \left(-\frac{13}{16}\right)\]
\[x_1 = \dfrac{61}{16}\]
Kyun: Aakhri row mein sirf ek unknown bacha hai, us ki value seedhi mil jati hai. Phir us se upar wali row mein sirf ek naya unknown hota hai, aur yun neeche se upar sab values mil jati hain. Isi ko back substitution kehte hain.

Reduced form: column 2 mein pivot ke upar zero
Row operation: \(R_1 + (-4)R_2 \to R_1'\)
\(R_1'\): \(1 + 0 = 1\), \(4 - 4 = 0\), \(1 + 0 = 1\) | \(2 + 1 = 3\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -\frac{1}{4} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{13}{16}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_1\) ke column 2 mein 4 hai, \(4R_2\) minus kiya. Constants: \(2 - 4\left(-\frac{1}{4}\right) = 2 + 1 = 3\).

Column 3 mein pivot ke upar zero
Row operation: \(R_1 + (-1)R_3 \to R_1'\)
\(R_1'\): \(1 + 0 = 1\), \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(1 - 1 = 0\) | \(3 + \frac{13}{16} = \frac{61}{16}\)
\[\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 0 & \frac{61}{16} \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -\frac{1}{4} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{13}{16}\end{array}\right]\]
Kyun: \(R_1\) ke column 3 mein 1 hai, \(R_3\) minus kiya: \(3 + \frac{13}{16} = \frac{61}{16}\). \(R_2\) mein pehle se 0 hai. Ab yeh reduced echelon form hai.

Reduced echelon form se jawab parhein
\[x_1 = \dfrac{61}{16}\]
\[x_2 = -\dfrac{1}{4}\]
\[x_3 = -\dfrac{13}{16}\]
Kyun: Reduced form ki har row seedha keh rahi hai: yeh unknown is number ke barabar hai. Dono tareeqon (back substitution aur reduced form) se ek hi jawab aaya, jo hamare kaam ki pehli tasdeeq hai.

Tasdeeq: asal equations mein rakh kar
\[\left(\frac{61}{16}\right) + 4\left(-\frac{1}{4}\right) + \left(-\frac{13}{16}\right) = 2 \;\checkmark\]
\[2\left(\frac{61}{16}\right) + \left(-\frac{1}{4}\right) - 2\left(-\frac{13}{16}\right) = 9 \;\checkmark\]
\[3\left(\frac{61}{16}\right) + \left(-\frac{1}{4}\right) - \left(-\frac{13}{16}\right) = 12 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Tasdeeq hamesha asal (di gayi) equations mein karein, reduced equations mein nahi, kyunke agar beech mein koi ghalti hui ho to reduced equations bhi ghalat hongi.
